_comment: Pelican Panel egg for Fluxer (self-hosted chat). Requires a Postgres database.
name: Fluxer
author: 71215245+VoidDeficit@users.noreply.github.com
description: Fluxer - open-source chat and voice platform (single-process mode) with a built-in PostgreSQL database.
startup: if [ ! -f data/.fluxer-init ]; then /opt/fluxer/current/bin/fluxerd init && touch data/.fluxer-init; fi; exec /opt/fluxer/current/bin/fluxerd run

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: Public domain Fluxer is served on, e.g. chat.example.com

variables.name: External Postgres URL (optional)
variables.description: Leave empty to use the built-in PostgreSQL stored in the server folder. Otherwise postgres://user:password@host:5432/dbname

variables.name: Public scheme
variables.description: https when a reverse proxy terminates TLS in front of this port, otherwise http

variables.name: Setup token
variables.description: Token for the first-run setup wizard (32-256 chars). Leave empty to have one generated and printed in the console once.

variables.name: KV mode
variables.description: Keep 'postgres' so no Valkey is needed

variables.name: Storage backend
variables.description: filesystem keeps uploads in the server's data folder

variables.name: Process mode
variables.description: single = all Rust services in one process

variables.name: Listen port
variables.description: Port Fluxer serves plain HTTP on (the server allocation)

variables.name: Edge site address
variables.description: Caddy site address for Fluxer's built-in edge. http://:PORT = plain HTTP, no automatic HTTPS; put a TLS reverse proxy in front.

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: IP ranges of your reverse proxy, space separated, whose X-Forwarded-For Fluxer trusts
